# Amaterasu — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is Amaterasu associated with?", "Japanese, Sun goddess"),
    ("What is notable about Amaterasu?", "Mirror"),
    ("What is context?", "Japanese, Sun goddess"),
    ("What is key fact?", "Mirror"),
    ("What is meaning?", "Ancestor of emperors"),
]

    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")

    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1

        print(f"Answer: {a}")
